headline: OpenAI announces expanded violence safeguards and recurring community-safety reporting
summary: OpenAI announced a recurring Community Safety Report on violence prevention and other community-safety issues, with the first report planned for early 2027 and six-month updates. It also says it is tightening responses to detailed requests about past mass attacks, extending teen limits to practical weapons and security-system information even without signs of violent intent, and developing context-sensitive chat interruption and account pauses for repeated conversations indicating violent fixation. OpenAI says rollout begins in the coming weeks. Earlier OpenAI materials already described a teen experience and age-prediction system with age-appropriate safeguards and an adult correction route. The new announcement describes additional restrictions, but neither the new nor prior material establishes deployment reach, accuracy or real-world safety outcomes.
